title: Amplifying a 5/8 success probability
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model whose efficient verifiers are closed under majority repetition, and let $L$ be a language of bit strings. If some efficient randomized verifier uses a number of random bits bounded by a polynomial in the input length and accepts members of $L$, and rejects nonmembers, each with probability at least $5/8$, then $L$ has such a verifier with both probabilities at least $2/3$.
hypotheses_covered: Efficient verifiers in $E$ are closed under majority repetition
$L$ has an $E$-efficient verifier with polynomially bounded randomness and success probability at least $5/8$ on members and nonmembers
